items.title: Tyrese Maxey and Anfernee Simons working out, with a cameo from Dominick Barlow, who has a wrap around his back.
items.author: Chris Hine
items.body_excerpt:
Tyrese Maxey and Anfernee Simons working out, with a cameo from Dominick Barlow, who has a wrap around his back. 

Barlow has been out with the back issue and not expected to be available the next two preseasons games. Simons also expected out the next 2 with a hamstring issue.

items.title: Sixers say that Dominick Barlow (back), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Adem Bona (foot) are not expected to play in either preseason games this week (tomorrow at Brooklyn, Saturday at Boston).

items.body_excerpt: Sixers say that Dominick Barlow (back), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Adem Bona (foot) are not expected to play in either preseason games this week (tomorrow at Brooklyn, Saturday at Boston).

items.title: Dominick Barlow is still out with a back issue, Anfernee Simons was a partial participant with hamstring tightness, Adem Bona has progressed to on-court work. All three are expected to be out for the next two preseason games.
